# Baptiste Dentistry for Kids

> > A pediatric dental practice in Apopka, FL specializing in child-centered dental care, preventive treatments, and restorative services led by experienced pediatric dentists.

Baptiste Dentistry for Kids is a dedicated pediatric dental practice serving families in Apopka, Florida. The practice is led by Dr. Alyssa Pinnock and Dr. Maryana Dalmeida, both specialists in children's dental health and preventive care.
